notes.title: Major update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We recently worked on an update for Infinity Boob Clicker. It contains a bunch of improvements and new breast physics and breast grabbing.
[h1]
Get ready to move some boobs![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862074/4c24f181898e58a7d31049ebaa350ae3ec24e631.gif[/img]

We listened to most people's suggestions and implemented a few of them. This was always supposed to be a small project, but we enjoyed everyone's feedback, and working on it again was fun!

[b]What can you expect from this new update?[/b]

[h2]News[/h2]

[list]
[*] New breast movement
[*] Drag and move them tits!
[*] Dialogue based on what you do
[*] Auto-Skip chest (you can collect them later
[*] Added a multiplication slider (to upgrade tools faster)
[*] Button to Hide UI and only enjoy Boobs
[*] New design for UI (very similar but more smooth overall)
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hits are now pooled by category (no more insane text on the screen)
[*] Improve feedback when opening the chest
[*] Remove double reward at the end of a stage
[*] Improve feedback when using the roulette
[*] Buy upgrade faster in one shot
[/list]

Thank to everyone who give us feedback and see the potential of our idea <3!

notes.title: Update: Chest + Statistic
notes.notes:
Hi guys and girls!

New update which contains a few bug fixes and new content, here the list:
[list]
[*] New Kiss Tool (act like a poison which apply damage overtime)
[*] 5 new effects (with Kiss tool)
[*] Statistic panel (you can see your progress from now on)
[*] Chest system (7 chest where added, they will drop every 5 round and 15% of the rest of the time)
[*] Color to differentiate hit tools
[*] Save at the end of each stages instead of only when the game close
[*] hair where not loading correctly
[*] Click tools is now increasing less fast for the first 80 level and drastically less for the rest of the progress
[/list]
We hope we can keep getting feedback from all of you!

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Hi guys and girls!

We just release the game and already have some of your feedback, we appreciate and are already applying them!

The game is quite small, so every idea has a chance to get in the game.

This quick update contains:

[list]
[*] Fix sound that was not playing when multiple sounds where playing
[*] Increase difficulty of Click tools after level 80 (your progress won't be affected, but the purchase is going to be higher now)
[*] Automatic tools are now 90% less strong
[*] Boobs Jiggle are now a bit more slow and exaggerated
[/list]

Thank you for the enthusiast of everyone!
